title: Albert Hall, Nottingham

terrainReference.basis: Fixed4moutside original native western front facade midpoint before any terrain acquisition. Threshold/sidewalk levels and sloping-front attachment are approximate; no flattened or fitted street terrain.

note: Complete native Hall footprint and signed front axis; deep brick hall, terracotta Baroque facade and open crowned tower. Roof partitions, section heights, concealed returns and exact pavement/host contact are photographic medium-fi estimates. Raw source terrain retained without fitting.
